title: Post-flight satisfaction survey: Likert grid, NPS 0–10, comments — Skyward Air
notes: v1 is a classic survey-tool page: a <table> Likert matrix (rows = journey stages, columns Very dissatisfied … Not applicable), an NPS fieldset of 11 radio inputs, numbered questions. v2 is a SvelteKit rewrite with renamed classes plus svelte-xxxxxxx scoping: each Likert row becomes a role=radiogroup card with pill labels, statements are reordered, the scale is reversed (Very satisfied first) and a 'Baggage delivery' row is added; the NPS question becomes a <sw-rating-scale> declarative shadow root with role=radio buttons and its question is a slotted <h2> with reworded copy. Decoys: an inserted 0–10 'choose Skyward Air for your next trip' scale (same component, another '9' button) placed before the NPS question, reordered checkbox tiles, and a site-wide 'Website feedback' widget with its own textarea and 'Submit feedback' button.
